plain_text:
Maurice Tarplin appears in 277 recordings across 12 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1938 to 1965. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Maurice Tarplin most often in Boston Blackie, The Mysterious Traveler, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Theater Five, The Shadow, Words at War, Columbia Workshop, and Cloak and Dagger.

Characters credited here include Inspector Faraday, The Mysterious Traveler, and Hercule Poirot.
